assumptions.S5_byte_estimate: 97+24*Bin bytes per party/edge (16 endpoint-mask + 24 envelope + current 57+24*Bin key serialization); lower bound only
assumptions.compact_shared_pad_option: M+1 union is a PROJECT_DERIVED identity-sharing extension and is not used for conservative sizing
assumptions.current_runtime_domain_limit: Protocol I layout currently pads logical n only through 1,048,576; a larger common-handle D requires a new domain API
assumptions.fixed_sample_pool: conditional only; requires fixed hidden sample-handle proof; direction-safe R2 union is s*(D-1)
assumptions.offline_full_pool_canonical_optimization: 8*C(D,2)+C(n,2), only if canonical comparison shares can safely derive the reverse bit without another one-shot key/Eval
assumptions.offline_full_pool_direction_safe: 8*D*(D-1)+n*(n-1), where D=next_power_of_two(2*M-n); one slot per ordered comparator request and stage/instance
assumptions.scores: signed int32 raw Q20.12 bit patterns
assumptions.slot_accounting: one ordered one-shot material request requires one party key slot at P0 and one at P1; canonical reuse is separately identified as conditional
assumptions.storage_padding: D-(2*M-n) addresses are capacity-only and are not S4 Select items

edge_coverage_enumeration.r3_r4_full_pool: D*(D-1) ordered slots per round and instance; C(D,2) only with a proven reverse-share complement transform
